description: This file implements a JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol for sending messages to agents, including both standard and streaming message requests. It defines message structures, request/response handling, metadata extraction, and functions for sending messages to A2A agents, including handling streamed responses with real-time updates.

methods.name: extractA2AMetadata
methods.description: Extracts task metadata from the A2A JSON-RPC response, including task ID, context ID, status, and custom metadata.

methods.name: makeA2ASendMessageRequest
methods.description: Sends a non-streaming message request to an A2A agent using JSON-RPC 2.0. Handles response parsing, error handling, and invoking callbacks with the response text and metadata.

methods.name: makeA2AStreamMessageRequest
methods.description: Sends a streaming message request to an A2A agent, processes NDJSON chunks in real-time, extracts response text, manages metadata updates, and handles stream errors.
